genus_diagnostics.habit: Trailing, prostrate, or twining herbs in the local core set.
genus_diagnostics.latex: Milky latex present in both current core species.
genus_diagnostics.leaves: Alternate, simple, commonly hastate/sagittate or lobed at the base.
genus_diagnostics.flowers: Axillary, usually 1–2 per cyme; broad funnel-shaped corolla.

quick_key.if: Plant soft-hairy/velvety; low trailing habit; leaves often broader and variably lobed; outer sepals ~7–8 mm and hairy
Plant essentially glabrous; long twining/prostrate stems; leaves narrower hastate/sagittate; sepals only ~3–4.3 mm
